title: Smoke-water effect on the germination of Amazonian tree species
why: Smoke-water germination of ten Amazonian trees (Ochroma pyramidale, Jacaranda copaia, Cordia goeldiana, Bellucia grossularioides, Swietenia macrophylla inhibited, Bertholletia excelsa faster); the abstract does not say which species rose, and the INPA copy (CC BY-NC-ND 3.0 BR) showed no PDF link, so no per-species sentence was seen.
